instruction.text: Complete the sentence with the missing word.

atoms.a: My grandfather always overcooks the spaghetti.
Mary always adds a teaspoon of sugar to her tea.
atoms.b: Mary always adds a ((teaspoon)) of sugar to her tea.

atoms.a: Let’s meet in the cafeteria and eat lunch.
atoms.b: Let’s meet in the ((cafeteria)) and eat lunch.

atoms.a: Not only does the restaurant have friendly staff, they also serve tasty food.
atoms.b: Not only does the ((restaurant)) have friendly staff, they also serve tasty food.

atoms.a: The pilot parks the aeroplane in the hangar.
atoms.b: The pilot parks the aeroplane in the ((hangar)).

atoms.a: There is no dust in space, so there is no need to vacuum.
atoms.b: There is no dust in space, so there is no need to ((vacuum)).
